summary: The historical baseline and old replay reproduce the reported failure: all five scheduled check-ins from turns 8–12 were silent. The candidate sent a visible message and recorded an action at every corresponding check-in, including repeated guard-status questions through the final turn. The called-out prolonged silence and absence of guard checks are no longer present.

criteria.claim: The Copilot must not remain silent across the five scheduled check-ins from turns 8 through 12.
At the scheduled wakes, the Copilot must check on the guard or solicit a status update rather than sending nothing through the end of the replay.

limitations: The old and candidate model configurations differ: the old replay used recorded-shift-trace with maxSteps 0, while the candidate used openai/gpt-5-mini with maxSteps 8.
Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
No guard replies, simulated or otherwise, were present, so the evidence establishes that the candidate initiated checks but not how a guard would respond.
Trigger-to-first-action latency measurements are null for both trajectories and therefore do not support a latency comparison.
